#   e <- ars(10000, dexp, domain = c(0, Inf), rate = 2)
#   z <- ars(10000, function(x) dnorm(x, log = TRUE), log = TRUE,
# density must return one numeric value per x. Expressions/formulas use x.
# ... supplies named arguments to density (or variables in an expression).
# domain is the open interval on which the density is strictly positive.
# initial contains at least two distinct interior points. On infinite tails,
# their derivatives must give an integrable envelope (positive on the left,
# negative on the right). Choose initial to bracket the mode when necessary.
# log=TRUE means density returns log densities; this avoids underflow.
# dlog, if supplied, is the vectorized derivative of the LOG density.
# Otherwise, domain-aware finite differences estimate derivatives.
# Checks detect violations at evaluated points; finite evaluations cannot
# certify global log-concavity of an arbitrary user function. Tiny numerical
# violations within tol are tolerated. No numerical integration is required.
.ars_stop(paste0(name, ' must be vectorized and return one finite numeric value per x.'))
if (length(density) != 2L) .ars_stop('Use a one-sided formula, such as ~ exp(-x^2/2).')
f <- function(x) eval(density, envir = c(list(x = x), args), enclos = envir)
} else .ars_stop('density must be a function, expression, or one-sided formula.')
.ars_stop('density must be strictly positive inside domain; use log=TRUE to avoid underflow.')

.ars_stop('Cannot estimate derivative at this numerical precision; supply dlog or rescale x.')
# Validate decreasing slopes and that each tangent supports neighboring nodes.
# Compare errors in log-density units, so rescaling x does not hide a
# curvature violation or merge meaningful tangents on a very wide domain.
.ars_stop('Log-concavity violation: log-density slopes or supporting tangents are inconsistent (or dlog is incorrect).')
# Integral of exp(h + slope * (t - x)) over [left, right], on log scale.
.ars_stop('Envelope is not integrable: choose initial points that bracket the mode.')

h + slope * (peak - x) + base::log(-expm1(-abs(slope) * (right - left))) - base::log(abs(slope))
# Construct the lower envelope of supporting tangents, clipping to domain.
near_parallel <- abs(dh[j] - dh[i]) <= tol * max(1, abs(dh[j]), abs(dh[i])) &&

# Numerically parallel tangents: retain the lower one. The second
# condition prevents small, meaningful slopes from being collapsed.
if (h[i] - dh[i] * x[i] >= h[j] - dh[j] * x[j]) {
.ars_stop('Log-concavity violation: tangent slopes must be nonincreasing.')
crossing <- x[j] + (h[i] - h[j] + dh[i] * (x[j] - x[i])) / (dh[j] - dh[i])
if (!is.finite(crossing)) .ars_stop('Numerically unstable tangent intersection; rescale the density or x.')
if (!skip) { ids <- c(ids, i); starts <- c(starts, crossing) }
ids <- ids[keep]; left <- left[keep]; right <- right[keep]
.ars_stop('Envelope mass is not finite; rescale inputs or choose different initial points.')
list(ids = ids, left = left, right = right, prob = weights / sum(weights),
# Invert a truncated exponential without exponentiating a large log density.
ars <- function(n, density, initial = NULL, domain = c(-Inf, Inf), ...,
.ars_stop('domain must be two increasing numeric bounds, possibly infinite.')
if (!is.null(dlog) && !is.function(dlog)) .ars_stop('dlog must be a function or NULL.')
.ars_stop('Additional density arguments must have unique names.')
if ('x' %in% names(args)) .ars_stop('x is reserved for density evaluation.')
dfun <- if (is.null(dlog)) function(x) .ars_derivative(x, hfun, domain) else
.ars_stop('initial must contain at least two distinct finite points strictly inside domain.')

x <- sort(initial); h <- hfun(x); dh <- dfun(x)
.ars_stop('Proposal reached a numerical boundary; rescale x or domain.')

# Reproducible, formal tests. Statistical tests use six-standard-error bounds
# for the mean and SD and a two-sided Kolmogorov-Smirnov threshold with
# P(false rejection) <= 2 exp(-2 * 2.8^2) under each continuous target.
# The fourth central moment determines the asymptotic standard error of SD.
# Test restores the caller's RNG state, writes actual normal draws, prints
# every result, returns an invisible data.frame, and fails loudly by default.
test <- function(n = 12000L, seed = 1992L, output_dir = '/app', stop_on_failure = TRUE) {
old_seed <- if (had_seed) get('.Random.seed', envir = .GlobalEnv) else NULL
if (exists('.Random.seed', envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)) rm('.Random.seed', envir = .GlobalEnv), add = TRUE)
record <- function(name, passed, mean = NA_real_, sd = NA_real_, detail = '') {
cat(sprintf('%s: %s mean=%.6f sd=%.6f%s\n', name, if (passed) 'PASS' else 'FAIL',
mean, sd, if (nzchar(detail)) paste0(' | ', detail) else ''))
mean = mean, sd = sd, detail = detail)
error = function(e) record(name, FALSE, detail = conditionMessage(e)))
tryCatch({ force(code); FALSE }, error = function(e) grepl(pattern, conditionMessage(e), ignore.case = TRUE))
cat('ARS formal tests: analytic module checks, validation, and known-distribution sampling.\n')
function(v) expect_error(ars(10, dnorm, domain = v), 'domain'), logical(1))))
expect_error(ars(10, dexp, domain = c(0, Inf), initial = c(0, 1)), 'initial'))
check('NONINTEGRABLE_ENVELOPE', expect_error(ars(10, dnorm, initial = c(1, 2)), 'not integrable'))
check('NON_LOG_CONCAVE', expect_error(ars(10, function(x) x^2, log = TRUE,
check('INCORRECT_DERIVATIVE', expect_error(ars(10, dnorm, dlog = function(x) x), 'Log-concavity'))
# Initial nodes all lie in an affine region; the first proposal exposes
# the convex section. A separate seed makes this regression reproducible.
log = TRUE, domain = c(0, 1), initial = c(.05, .1)), 'Log-concavity')
distribution <- function(name, sampler, cdf, mu, sigma, fourth, bounds = c(-Inf, Inf), save = FALSE) {
passed <- length(z) == n && all(is.finite(z)) && all(z > bounds[1] & z < bounds[2]) &&
abs(m - mu) < mean_limit && abs(s - sigma) < sd_limit && ks < 2.8/sqrt(n)
row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
record(name, passed, m, s, sprintf('truth mean=%.6f sd=%.6f; KS D=%.5f (limit %.5f)',
}, error = function(e) record(name, FALSE, detail = conditionMessage(e)))
distribution('NORMAL', function() ars(n, dnorm), pnorm, 0, 1, 3, save = TRUE)
distribution('EXPONENTIAL', function() ars(n, dexp, domain = c(0, Inf), rate = 2,
function() ars(n, dexp, domain = c(0, Inf), rate = 2),
function() ars(n, dnorm, initial = c(-2, 2), max_points = 2),
distribution('GAMMA', function() ars(n, dgamma, domain = c(0, Inf), shape = 3, rate = 2),
distribution('UNIFORM', function() ars(n, dunif, domain = c(0, 1)),
distribution('BETA', function() ars(n, dbeta, domain = c(0, 1), shape1 = 2, shape2 = 2),
function() ars(n, function(x) 1000 - (x - 5)^2/8, log = TRUE, initial = c(2, 5, 8)),
if (stop_on_failure && any(!summary$passed)) .ars_stop('ARS formal tests failed; see results above.')
